## About
Apple Auto Dismantling sells used auto parts out of our yard on E Anaheim St in Wilmington. Local body shops and folks fixing their own cars come to us when they need a part.
You can search our inventory by part, by image, or several parts at once. Or call the counter and we'll check for you. We hold a 4 rating from 226 Google reviews.

## Services
- Used auto parts: Parts pulled from vehicles at our Wilmington yard, ready for pickup at the counter.
- Inventory search: Look up what we have in stock. You can search by part, search by image, or run a multiple part search.

## FAQ
Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Yes. We offer a 90 day warranty.

Q: What forms of payment do you take?
A: We take all credit cards.
